Spreek jij native of near-native Nederlands? Lees dan verder!

Wil jij als Senior .Net Ontwikkelaar onderdeel zijn van een agile DevOps team dat business kritische applicaties ontwikkelt, test en onderhoudt?

Jouw rol in ons team

Als Senior .NET Ontwikkelaar ben je verantwoordelijk voor (een deel van) het ontwerp van één of meerdere systemen. Deze rol vereist communicatie en interactie met meerdere ontwikkel- en testteams en met de andere ontwerp-autoriteiten. In jouw rol treedt jij op als de vertegenwoordiger van de technische aspecten van het systeem bij het overleg met de klant.

Hoe jij ons team versterkt

Jij bent veelzijdig en bereid om die extra stap te zetten die soms nodig is. Jij bent proactief en weet anderen gemakkelijk voor jouw ideeën te winnen. Jij bent analytisch sterk, gaat op je doel af en behaalt graag resultaat, samen met je team. Daarnaast heb jij:

Een afgeronde HBO of WO opleiding met een sterke ICT component
Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar aantoonbare praktijkervaring met .NET backend ontwikkeling
Kennis van webservices (WCF en REST WebApi)
Kennis en ervaring met Azure Cloud
Kennis van Microsoft SQL server, SQL en datamodellering
Ervaring in het gebruik van tooling als Azure DevOps en GIT
Ervaring met web-development frameworks zoals ASP.NET (Core MVC). JavaScript en/of Typescript, HTML en CSS is een pré
Affiniteit met AWS is een pré
Ervaring met scrum / agile
Ervaring met frontend frameworks zoals Angualr, Vue of React
Kennis van Containerized applications (Docker)
Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands

Een pre-employment screening maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure

Waarom CGI

CGI is één van 's werelds grootste IT-consultancy bedrijven. Onze mensen houden Nederland draaiende. Overheidsinstellingen, banken, lucht- en ruimtevaart, infrastructurele organisaties en energie- en productiebedrijven zijn klanten van CGI. We werken aan interessante projecten die het alledaagse leven van miljoenen mensen raken. We zijn regionaal aanwezig, versterkt met wereldwijde domeinkennis, ons ecosysteem en collega's verspreid over de hele wereld.

We zijn trots op de impactvolle projecten die we samen met onze collega’s tot een succes maken.

Bij CGI hechten we veel waarde aan diversiteit en inclusie, omdat dit niet alleen de samenwerking bevordert, maar ook vaak leidt tot betere resultaten. We kijken uit naar jouw bijdrage aan ons team!

Werken in kleine zelfsturende teams bestaande uit experts in je vakgebied.

De regie over je eigen carrière met daarbij de ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen.
Je werkt met de nieuwste technologieën.
Een uitstekend salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden
Direct een vast contract
Parttime mogelijkheden
En de mogelijkheid om CGI aandeelhouder te worden

Waar kom je terecht

Vanuit de vestiging in Groningen, met ongeveer 180 collega's, bedient CGI klanten in Oost- en Noord-Nederland, voornamelijk in de unit Energy, Utilities en Manufacturing. Hier maak je deel uit van het Energy, Utilities en Manufacturing team en draag je bij aan de waarde voor CGI en klanten, terwijl je kunt profiteren van de kennis en ervaring van zowel je regionale teamleden als meer dan 100 collega's in het Manufacturing Center of Excellence in Arnhem.

Sluit je aan bij ons team van experts en solliciteer direct!

Meer informatie over de inhoud van de vacature? Neem contact op met Leon Bosgra (Director Consulting Services) via leon.bosgra@cgi.com.

Vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? neem contact op met recruiter Nick Damen via nick.damen@cgi.com of 06-11704742.

We werken niet samen met externe recruitment bureau’s. Acquisitie wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Criteria

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
About The Role

Senior Software Developer

📍Location: Gorinchem, Netherlands (Hybrid)
Industry: Software Development / Industrial Technology / Technology Solutions
Job Function: Software Engineering / Software Development

Employment Type: Full-Time

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Developer to join a highly technical and collaborative engineering team based in Gorinchem on a Hybrid basis. This is an opportunity to work on complex software systems where modern cloud-native technologies intersect with existing enterprise, embedded, and industrial software environments.

The successful candidate will play a key role in designing scalable architectures, modernising existing systems, and delivering robust software solutions that support long-term business objectives. You will work in an Agile Scrum environment, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams while contributing to architectural decisions, technical strategy, and continuous improvement initiatives.

This position is ideal for a software engineer who thrives in complexity, enjoys solving challenging technical problems, and can balance innovation with the realities of existing software landscapes. You will have the opportunity to influence technical direction, mentor others through best practices, and help shape future-proof solutions within a highly structured engineering environment.

Key Responsibilities

Design and evolve scalable software architectures that support long-term maintainability and technical sustainability.
Develop and maintain backend and full-stack software solutions using Microsoft technologies and modern development frameworks.
Work within complex software environments, including legacy systems, enterprise applications, and embedded software components.
Build, maintain, and optimise APIs and system integrations across distributed environments.
Contribute to software modernisation initiatives, including migration projects involving .NET Core and modern .NET architectures.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to define technical solutions and implementation strategies.
Participate actively in Agile Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure software quality, performance, scalability, and security through best engineering practices.
Support architectural decision-making and provide technical guidance on complex development projects.
Identify opportunities to improve system performance, reliability, and maintainability.

Your Profile

Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Proven experience as a Senior Software Developer or Senior Software Engineer working on complex software systems.
Strong expertise in C#, .NET Framework, and modern .NET technologies.
Experience designing and delivering scalable, maintainable backend solutions.
Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and engineering best practices.
Experience working within Agile Scrum development environments.
Ability to work effectively within both modern and legacy software landscapes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability for software delivery.
Fluent in both English and Dutch.

Preferred Experience

.NET Core, .NET 6, .NET 8, or later versions.
Cloud-native application development.
API development and systems integration.
Enterprise software development.
Embedded or industrial software environments.
Distributed systems and microservices architectures.
Software modernisation and migration projects.
Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and benefits package.
Long-term career development and progression opportunities.
Supportive team culture with opportunities to contribute to technical strategy and decision-making.

Apply today or contact Arthur Mahoney for more information about this opportunity.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will collaborate with a global network of technologists, designers, and strategists to help clients transform their businesses through innovative digital solutions.

You’ll develop cutting-edge products, mentor client teams, and shape engineering cultures while growing your expertise across diverse industries and technologies.

You will work hands-on with clients across industries to bring their digital ambitions to life. You will develop software products and services from the ground up while coaching and mentoring client teams on engineering best practices, user-centric design, and Agile values. By co-creating with clients and their leadership, you’ll help build not only cutting-edge products but also the technical capabilities and cultures needed to sustain them.

Your work will drive meaningful change for clients and their industries. You will participate in cross-functional problem-solving sessions with client leaders, shaping their digital strategies and delivering solutions that go beyond the product itself. Your efforts will help clients build scalable teams and engineering cultures that enable long-term success.

You will collaborate with clients across industries to turn their digital ambitions into reality through hands-on technical expertise. Based in one of our global locations, you will be part of QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, a multidisciplinary group of software engineers, AI engineers, data scientists, and technology consultants passionate about creating industry-shaping products and tools.

You’ll grow as a technologist and leader. You’ll work across diverse industries and technologies, learning something new with every project. With opportunities to contribute to digital strategies, build impactful products, and mentor others, you’ll have the freedom to chart your own path and grow in the areas that excite you most.

Your Qualifications and Skills

Undergraduate or master’s degree; or equivalent experience
2+ years of experience developing full-stack applications by writing code that is readable, testable, maintainable, and scalable
Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with other developers, as well as technical and non-technical people within software teams
Hands-on experience and willingness to learn across frontend (TypeScript, React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind), backend (Python, Node.js, Java/Spring, C#/.NET), and databases (SQL, NoSQL, vector databases, ETL)
Experience with LLM frameworks, prompt orchestration, agent frameworks, MCPs, evaluation frameworks, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), including Docker and CI/CD
Strong focus on automated testing, logging, monitoring, and overall system reliability
Experience working in Agile teams, including active participation in sprint ceremonies
Experience pair programming collaboratively with other developers
Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

jobs.description:
Wat je gaat doen

Ben jij een senior .NET Engineer
die méér wil dan standaardwerk? Wil je werken aan uitdagende
, impactvolle projecten, waar jij vanaf het eerste strategische idee tot de optimalisatie
een sleutelrol speelt? Dan is iO dé plek voor jou.

Bij iO werk je niet zomaar aan applicaties. Jij helpt grote namen zoals Landal GreenParks, Enexis en Efteling
om hun digitale uitdagingen op te lossen. Hoe zorgen we voor meer boekingen? Hoe kunnen we AI inzetten om de klantenservice te verbeteren? Jij denkt verder dan code – jij bouwt slimme oplossingen die écht impact maken. En dat doe je niet door simpelweg code te schrijven en door te gaan naar het volgende project? Nee, bij iO ben je onderdeel van het hele proces: van de eerste strategische sessies tot de oplevering én de doorontwikkeling.

En dat betekent:

✔ Vanaf dag één betrokken zijn bij de strategie en architectuur.

✔ Werken aan high-performance applicaties
met de nieuwste .NET-technologieën.

✔ Code controleren op consistentie, complexiteit en schaalbaarheid.

✔ Samenwerken in een multidisciplinair team
met designers, strategen en marketeers. Kennisdeling staat centraal en samen met jouw team bepaal jij de route.

✔ Jouw eigen pad bepalen – dedicated werken voor één klant of juist variatie in projecten. Wij stemmen projecten af op jouw ambities.

✔ Geen repetitief werk
– elke uitdaging is anders en vraagt om een unieke aanpak.

✔ Ruimte voor groei
– Expert Groups, certificeringen en inspirerende events.

Wil jij bouwen aan digitale oplossingen die écht het verschil maken? Neem contact met ons op
en ontdek hoe jij je bij iO kunt ontwikkelen! 🚀

Daarom ben jij de perfecte .NET Engineer

✔ Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met .NET
en een stevige kennis van design patterns.

✔ Ervaring met Sitecore, Umbraco of Optimizely
is een plus, interesse is een must.

✔ Je overziet de volledige architectuur
en maakt doordachte technische keuzes.

✔ Agile mindset
– je hebt eerder gewerkt met Scrum en weet hoe je in een team impact maakt.

✔ Je communiceert helder en spreekt en schrijft foutloos Nederlands.

Dit krijg jij van ons

25 vakantiedagen

Op basis van een 40-urige werkweek.

Reiskosten & vakantiegeld

Uiteraard kun je rekenen op 8% vakantiegeld. Daarnaast hebben we verschillende mobiliteitsregelingen, maar afhankelijk van jouw functie en voorkeur een keuze.

Goede pensioenregeling

Jij legt 4% in en iO vult de rest aan tot de volledige premie.

Hybride werken

Een goede werk- en privébalans is superbelangrijk. Samen met jouw team maak je afspraken over wanneer én waar je werkt.

Gezonde snacks & lunch

Op iedere iO campus pak je de hele dag een gezond tussendoortje en kun je tegen een kleine vergoeding gezond én gevarieerd lunchen.

Persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget

Zet jaarlijks € 3.000,- in om jezelf te ontwikkelen, in je vak of als persoon, met trainingen, events of cursussen.

Milestones & celebrations

En bovenal zijn we bij iO ook gewoon een gezellige club mensen, al zeggen we het zelf. Het Fun & Party-team op jouw campus staat op z'n tijd dan ook garant voor de leukste feestjes.

jobs.title: Intern Software Developer Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
About Kinaxis

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end-to-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in Rotterdam and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Our Rotterdam office is a highly collaborative and flexible workspace located near the central railway station in the heart of the city.  O ur office serves as a centralized hub where employees and customers can come together to work towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains. People matter at Kinaxis and we are committed to helping you grow professionally as you take the first step in crafting your career journey. 

Location

This is a hybrid position. You must be in the Rotterdam, Netherlands office, at least three days a week.

About The Team

The Supply Chain Execution (SCE) Development team is a dynamic group of around 20 passionate software engineers working across three agile teams in Rotterdam, Hyderabad, and Bangalore. We pride ourselves on being truly global—our Rotterdam team alone represents 10 different nationalities! jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will lead architecture design, drive technology decisions, and co-create innovative products while mentoring clients to adopt Agile practices and engineering excellence.

You will have hands-on collaboration, diverse industry exposure, and opportunities to shape solutions and grow as a technology leader.

You will lead project workstreams, drive architectural decisions, and build scalable solutions using Agile methodologies. Working closely with client teams, you will co-create products, foster a culture of engineering excellence, and mentor teams in best practices. Your responsibilities will include shaping technical strategies, making key technology decisions, and ensuring the delivery of impactful, user-centric solutions.

Your work will have a lasting impact beyond the products you build. By collaborating with client leadership, you will influence their digital strategies, help scale their engineering cultures, and enable them to achieve sustainable growth. Each project will expose you to diverse industries and technologies, providing opportunities to learn and grow while shaping the future of technology.

You will design and deliver next-generation products that transform businesses across industries. Based in one of our global locations, you will be part of QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, a multidisciplinary group of software engineers, AI engineers, data scientists, and technology consultants passionate about creating industry-shaping products and tools.

You will have unparalleled opportunities for growth and innovation. You’ll have a seat at the table with client leaders, the chance to shape product strategies, and the freedom to explore areas of personal interest. Supported by a collaborative and innovative team, you’ll make a lasting impact on clients, industries, and the future of technology.

Your Qualifications and Skills

Bachelors, Master’s or PhD level degree in a discipline such as: computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering or artificial intelligence
7+ years of experience in software development, with significant full-stack web application development experience strongly preferred
Experience working collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members and stakeholders
Hands-on experience and willingness to learn across frontend (TypeScript, React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind), backend (Python, Node.js, Java/Spring, C#/.NET), and databases (SQL, NoSQL, vector databases, ETL)
Experience with LLM frameworks, prompt orchestration, agent frameworks, MCPs, evaluation frameworks, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), including Docker and CI/CD
Strong focus on automated testing, logging, monitoring, and overall system reliability
Experience modeling and coaching others to use engineering best practices such as design patterns, customer-centric design, test-driven development, code refactoring, code review, and OWASP Top 10 security awareness
Experience leading in Agile teams, including coaching and modeling Agile mindsets as part of sprint ceremonies, work definition and building developer capabilities
Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in German and English, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

jobs.title: Staff Software Developer (IAM)
jobs.description:
At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started back in 2000, we have strived to create the strongest and most effective developer tools in the world. Today, we are evolving beyond standalone tools toward a unified, AI-native platform for software development.

AI is no longer just an assistant inside the editor – it is becoming an active participant in how software is planned, built, reviewed, and operated across teams and organizations. This shift brings challenges that cannot be solved at the level of individual tools alone, challenges that involve governance, security, cost control, observability, and coordination between humans and autonomous agents.

The JetBrains Platform team (JCP)
is building the foundation that connects developer workflows, team-level collaboration, and organizational control into a single coherent system. The platform is both deeply integrated with JetBrains products and designed to work across teams, products, and environments.

We’re now looking for an experienced Software Engineer
to join an identity management and access team in JCP. The team owns several services responsible for authentication and authorization, as well as for managing organizations, user memberships, groups, and workspaces. All these form a foundational dependency for the rest of the platform. We also supply and support robust authentication components used by YouTrack, IDE Services, License Vault, Qodana, and other JetBrains products.

In This Role, You Will

Own the entire SDLC: codebase, architecture, and operations
Maintain and evolve the services in Kotlin and a little bit of Go, ensuring reliability and performance as the platform grows
Design and implement new features across the identity, organization, membership, group, and workspace domains
Review and integrate PRs from other platform teams
Manage integrations with other JCP platform components and connected applications

We will be happy to have you on our team if you:

Have 7+ years of JVM development experience, preferably with Kotlin
Know how to approach performance problems on JVM and Postgres
Are experienced in building and operating SaaS production services in a distributed, multi-tenant environment
Can fluently navigate a modern devops stack: K8S, OpenTelemetry, Grafana
Have a track record of taking over and improving existing production services

Nice To Have

Prior experience with identity management protocols, such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML 2.0, or SCIM 2.0
If you have designed and evolved domain models for organizational or identity systems
Cybersecurity experience: estimating risks, recognizing common vulnerability antipatterns, and promoting best SSDLC practices
Hands-on experience with Go

Why join JetBrains?

Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible. (depending on location)
Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.
Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.
Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.
Some benefits may vary depending on location.

We are an equal opportunity employer

We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the Recruitment Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will lead architecture design, drive technology decisions, and co-create innovative products while mentoring clients to adopt Agile practices and engineering excellence.

You will have hands-on collaboration, diverse industry exposure, and opportunities to shape solutions and grow as a technology leader.

You will lead project workstreams, drive architectural decisions, and build scalable solutions using Agile methodologies. Working closely with client teams, you will co-create products, foster a culture of engineering excellence, and mentor teams in best practices. Your responsibilities will include shaping technical strategies, making key technology decisions, and ensuring the delivery of impactful, user-centric solutions.

Your work will have a lasting impact beyond the products you build. By collaborating with client leadership, you will influence their digital strategies, help scale their engineering cultures, and enable them to achieve sustainable growth. Each project will expose you to diverse industries and technologies, providing opportunities to learn and grow while shaping the future of technology.

You will design and deliver next-generation products that transform businesses across industries. Based in one of our global locations, you will be part of QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, a multidisciplinary group of software engineers, AI engineers, data scientists, and technology consultants passionate about creating industry-shaping products and tools.

You will have unparalleled opportunities for growth and innovation. You’ll have a seat at the table with client leaders, the chance to shape product strategies, and the freedom to explore areas of personal interest. Supported by a collaborative and innovative team, you’ll make a lasting impact on clients, industries, and the future of technology.

Your Qualifications and Skills

Bachelors, Master’s or PhD level degree in a discipline such as: computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering or artificial intelligence
7+ years of experience in software development, with significant full-stack web application development experience strongly preferred
Experience working collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members and stakeholders
Hands-on experience and willingness to learn across frontend (TypeScript, React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind), backend (Python, Node.js, Java/Spring, C#/.NET), and databases (SQL, NoSQL, vector databases, ETL)
Experience with LLM frameworks, prompt orchestration, agent frameworks, MCPs, evaluation frameworks, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), including Docker and CI/CD
Strong focus on automated testing, logging, monitoring, and overall system reliability
Experience modeling and coaching others to use engineering best practices such as design patterns, customer-centric design, test-driven development, code refactoring, code review, and OWASP Top 10 security awareness
Experience leading in Agile teams, including coaching and modeling Agile mindsets as part of sprint ceremonies, work definition and building developer capabilities
Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in German and English, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

The London Market division of Hiscox focuses on big ticket speciality risks such as Marine and Energy, Major Property, Casualty, Crisis Management and Portfolio Solutions, and is regarded a leader in these fields. Work with DevOps engineers to enhance CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and deployment processes.
Model and optimise data across SQL and NoSQL stores.

Participate in code reviews, technical discussions and agile ceremonies.

Strong communication, and interpersonal skills.

Strong commercial experience with .NET Core / ASP.NET Core for backend development.

Hands-on experience with Kafka (preferably AWS MSK) for messaging/stream processing.

Good understanding of DevOps concepts, with practical experience using Git and working with CI/CD tooling (e.g. GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI or similar).
Experience with both SQL (e.g. SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g. DynamoDB, MongoDB).

Comfortable working in an agile environment (Scrum/Kanban).
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail and a collaborative mindset.

Experience delivering systems on GCP.

Job Title

Founding Engineer - Early Careers

£50K – £70K + Equity

Company Description

Tracebit is a $20M Series A London cybersecurity startup backed by FirstMark and Accel that builds cloud intrusion detection using canaries. Their decoy tripwire technology protects major organizations like Riot Games, Docker, and Snyk, recently gaining acclaim for discovering a critical P1 security flaw in Google's Gemini CLI.

Job Description

As a Founding Engineer at Tracebit, you will join an elite team building honeytoken-based security tools. Reporting to the Engineering Lead, you will ship production code daily across the full stack while utilizing cutting-edge AI development tools. This role offers unparalleled learning velocity and founder exposure in a high-growth, office-based environment.

Location

London, UK

Why this role is remarkable

Join a high-growth startup that just raised a $20M Series A led by FirstMark and Accel to redefine cloud security.
Unparalleled learning velocity with founder-level exposure and the chance to influence a product already trusted by global tech giants.
Work in a high-talent environment that recently discovered a P1 security flaw in Google’s Gemini CLI, ensuring your work has global impact.

What You Will Do

Build and deploy decoy tripwires using C# on .NET Core 10, Terraform, and HTMX to detect advanced cloud intrusions.
Collaborate directly with the CTO and Engineering Lead to ship customer-facing features daily with minimal bureaucracy or process.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools like Claude and Codex to accelerate your engineering output and solve complex architectural challenges.

The ideal candidate

Strong academic foundation with a degree in a STEM subject like Computer Science or Physics and a track record of excellence.
Proven ability to write clean, correct code in a known language with a deep curiosity for how systems function.
Demonstrated passion for building through side projects, open-source contributions, or hackathons, showing a clear bias for action and delivery.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

jobs.description:
This role is based in the United Kingdom. You will be required to interview in person.

Must be a UK Citizen.

About SailPoint
SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots.

Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.
About the role.

As a Staff Software Engineer at SailPoint, you will architect, build, and deliver high-performance cloud services that form the core decision-making brain of our identity platform. In this role, your day-to-day will involve designing resilient full-stack solutions using Golang and Angular, engineering synchronous and event-driven microservices, and pioneering AI-assisted and agentic development workflows. You will collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, architects, and global engineering peers to translate complex identity governance concepts into performant, elegant, and secure production systems. You will also take active ownership of technical excellence across our codebase through architecture reviews, system profiling, and developer mentorship.

About the team
You will join the UK Platform Engineering team, a collaborative, high-velocity group responsible for designing, building, and running foundational services for SailPoint. Our team currently features a strong mix of backend and frontend specialists transitioning to end-to-end full-stack development to support cutting-edge AI and identity initiatives. We value autonomy, continuous learning, and close teamwork, staying connected through day-to-day collaboration and meeting in person once per quarter for team offsites.

Roadmap for success
30 days:
Complete SailPoint engineering onboarding, development environment setup, and security compliance training.

Shadow team members to understand the architecture, API contracts, and deployment pipelines of the Policy Engine.

Deliver your first bug fix or minor feature contribution to production using Golang or Angular.

60 days:
Partner with technical leads, architects, and product managers to define technical specifications and rough estimates for upcoming roadmap items.

Build, test, and deploy end-to-end features supporting real-time and batch policy evaluation workflows.

Conduct thorough code reviews and collaborate with peers on unit and integration testing strategies.

6 months:
Lead the autonomous design, implementation, and deployment of complex features across the Policy Engine and SailPoint Agentic Fabric.

Establish debug and performance profiling benchmarks to improve service latency, throughput, and reliability.

Participate in the 24x7 engineering on-call support rotation (approximately 1 week in 20) and drive operational improvements.

1 year:
Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Policy Engine services and distributed system architecture.

Mentor and coach junior and mid-level software engineers on modern software design patterns, Golang, Angular, and AI-assisted tooling.

Drive cross-functional architectural initiatives in collaboration with engineering teams worldwide as the platform scales.

Requirements
Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience

8+ years of professional software development experience

Proven expertise in backend microservice design and development, preferably using Golang

Strong experience developing modern web frontends, preferably using Angular

Solid foundation in automated testing and debugging, including unit, integration, and performance profiling tools

Experience designing and maintaining scalable microservices within a distributed SaaS cloud environment

Excellent collaboration, problem-solving, and communication skills

Preferred Skills & Tech Stack
Tech Stack: Golang, Angular, Java, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudBees/Jenkins

Hands-on experience with cloud databases such as Amazon DynamoDB, Aurora, or Snowflake

Experience building data streaming and event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka or Apache Flink

Experience or strong interest in AI-assisted software development and agentic engineering practices

AI-assisted engineering:
Our engineers are expected to use AI development tools as a core part of their daily workflow, not as a novelty. We expect you to use these tools to accelerate delivery, expand your scope, and raise the quality bar, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything that ships under your name. Comfort with prompting, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated code is a baseline expectation for this role.

Python-based AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, and numpy

LLMs and Foundation Models in Bedrock, VertexAI, or similar

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering
is the team that builds and supports the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences
. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About The Role

We’re looking for a product-focused Software Engineer II
to join our fast-growing Experiences Engineering team. This is a full-stack role, leveraging Java, SQL, React, AWS and AI tools
. It’s ideal for mid-level engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, shipping frequently, and working in a modern cloud environment. You’ll play a key role in building high-impact features that power millions of traveler experiences globally.

We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model
with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally up to 1.5 hours) of one of our office hubs in Oxford.

What You’ll Do

Drive Impact: Connect your engineering work directly to traveler value by owning features from design to deployment.
Shape the Product: Partner with product, design, and data teams to influence what we build, helping to define specifications and find the most efficient path to success.
Collaborate & Mentor: Review code, provide thoughtful feedback, and coach less experienced engineers to maintain a high bar for quality.
Innovate with AI: Use agentic AI as a daily partner to plan approaches, automate routine tasks, and focus your energy on solving more complex technical challenges.
Champion Operational Health: Take hands-on ownership of system reliability by building monitoring dashboards, managing alerts and support cases, and fixing underlying bugs to continuously improve service resilience and eliminate operational toil.
Build for Quality: Design and implement clean, maintainable solutions with a focus on performance, security, and automated testing.

Skills & Experience

We typically look for a minimum of 2-3 years’ experience, following a Bachelor’s degree or above in Comp Science or a related field.

Full-Stack Mindset: Experience developing web apps, including proficiency in a modern backend language (e.g., Java, C#, Go, Python) and familiarity with relational databases.
Problem Solving: A strong grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and the ability to apply them to real-world distributed systems.
Data-Driven: A habit of using operational data and experiment results to validate that your changes had the intended effect.
AI Coding: you are fluent coding with either Cursor or Codex/Claude/Open Code.
Global Mindset: Ability to operate effectively within a global team, communicating clearly about progress and blockers.

We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. However, we’re especially interested if you’ve had exposure to AWS, React, or NoSQL databases. More than any specific tool, we value curiosity and the ability to solve problems creatively.

We value engineers from different technical backgrounds. You can complete our coding interview exercises
in any language of your choice, but need to be open to working within the Java ecosystem when you join!

What We Offer

Competitive compensation packages, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.
“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations.
Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveller first: We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.
Execution is our edge: We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.
We succeed together: The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

Discover more in our Tech Blog, for an inside look into some of our exciting and ground-breaking technical projects here at Tripadvisor Group.

Tripadvisor Group champions the unique identities, abilities, and experiences of all our people – employees, customers, and partners. jobs.description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior
C# Developer
to join our team, which focuses on two main areas:

Veeam Explorers - granular recovery for SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Exchange and SharePoint - where we expose browse and restore through REST and gRPC so they can be driven from the Web UI, PowerShell and automation.
Active Directory Forest Recovery as part of Identity Resilience, which rebuilds an entire AD forest after a domain-wide outage or ransomware attack.

Both are the same kind of system: a server orchestrating a remote agent over a versioned contract, running operations that take hours and must survive failure at any step.

What You'll Do

Design and implement recovery flows end-to-end — REST and gRPC contracts, server-side orchestration, and the agent that executes on the target machine
Build PowerShell cmdlets as a first-class product surface, with parameter validation and a coherent object model
Design pre-flight validation that catches issues before a restore starts, across REST, server and agent layers
Work close to what you're recovering: SQL Server, Oracle and PostgreSQL internals, or Active Directory — domain controller promotion, SYSVOL and NTDS, DNS, Kerberos, replication
Manage long-running distributed sessions: agent deployment, keep-alive, cleanup on failure and timeout, cancellation
Own your integration test suite and keep it green
Refactor a long-lived codebase as you go — this is a mature product, and improving what's there is part of the job

Technologies We Work With:
C#, .NET, REST, gRPC / Protobuf, PowerShell, multithreading and async, Windows Server and Active Directory, Linux, MS SQL / PostgreSQL / Oracle, VMware and Hyper-V, Git, TFS, Visual Studio, Rider

5+ years of commercial C# product development, with a deep understanding of .NET, data structures and algorithms
Experience designing service APIs — REST, gRPC or similar — where consumers are external and backward compatibility matters
Strong async and multithreading: cancellation, session lifecycle, hours-long operations
Depth in at least one of: Windows Server and Active Directory administration or internals; or database recovery mechanics for SQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL
Comfort in a large existing codebase: reading unfamiliar code, refactoring safely
English for daily work in an international team

At Lumilens we are building the critical photonics infrastructure that powers tomorrow’s AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing faster, cooler, and massively more efficient.

We’re a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by veterans who’ve built and scaled some of the most transformative technologies in the industry. This isn’t incremental innovation, it’s a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. You’ll work alongside a team of world-class engineers solving some of the hardest challenges in optics, systems, and scale. Every line of code, every design decision, every breakthrough you help deliver will shape the infrastructure of tomorrow.

If you're looking for mission, momentum, and the chance to make an outsized impact—jump on the rocket ship. We’re just getting started ... and we are building a Team in Kraków!

What You Will Work On

C# / .NET desktop application — Advanced manufacturing software for optical transceiver testing. A GUI application built with MVVM architecture, featuring multi-threaded test execution, instrument resource management, and RPC services.
Hardware integration — Writing drivers and control code for laboratory equipment, managing parallel test execution and handling complex locking across instruments.
Python test scripts & libraries – Our manufacturing software draws the best from both worlds. You will have the opportunity to integrate complex testing functionality based on Python code embedded natively into the .NET application.
Manufacturing scale - You will be developing software that runs on manufacturing lines, producing thousands of units daily.

Required Skills:

5+ years of C#/.NET — experience with GUI (WPF or similar framework), MVVM, async/await, thread safety, and class library design
Strong command of concurrent programming — designing thread-safe systems, avoiding race conditions, and reasoning about execution across multiple threads and processes
Experience with .NET 8 or later
3+ years of Python — OOP, pytest, abstraction-driven design
Solid understanding of clean architecture — separation of concerns, dependency inversion, dependency injection, and testability
MongoDB or similar document database — data modeling, querying, and managing test results at scale
Analytical mindset — proven ability to break down complex multi-component failures, trace issues across process boundaries, and design reliable solutions under ambiguity
Ability to debug remotely without direct debugger access — diagnosing issues via logs, traces, and telemetry

Infrastructure & Tooling

Git & CI/CD fluency — GitHub Actions, artifact pipelines, versioning strategies, and automated deployment to remote Windows machines
Bash and/or PowerShell scripting for automation, remote management, and deployment
Systems-level thinking

Nice to Have

Experience with test and measurement instruments (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power meters)
Experience with Unit Tests: xUnit, MSTest, etc.
Knowledge of optical communications, photonics, or transceiver technology
Python.net experience
Familiarity with hardware interfaces – serial communication, TCP sockets, low-level protocols and interfaces (I2C, GPIB), and instrument communication standards (SCPI, VISA)
Familiarity with factory/manufacturing software or MES integration

What we offer

Competitive salary commensurate with experience
Professional development opportunities and certification support
Access to cutting-edge technology and cloud platforms
Collaborative work environment with cross-functional teams

jobs.description:

O nas

Tworzymy i rozwijamy autorskie produkty oraz dedykowane aplikacje dla dużych polskich i międzynarodowych przedsiębiorstw. Budujemy je w architekturze mikroserwisowej, w Javie, .NET, Node.js, TypeScripcie i uruchamiamy w kontenerach.

Nasze systemy działają w All for One Data Center, w infrastrukturach klientów oraz w chmurach publicznych: AWS, Azure i GCP. Wybór dostawcy chmury nie jest tu kluczowy, ponieważ pracujemy przede wszystkim z warstwą aplikacyjną i z procesem jej dostarczania.

Rekrutujemy do Działu Rozwoju Oprogramowania
, dlatego stanowisko jest bliżej obszaru Dev niż Ops
. Infrastrukturę przygotowuje i utrzymuje nasz dział IT lub klient: system operacyjny, sieć, silnik Dockera oraz klaster Kubernetes.

Twoja odpowiedzialność zaczyna się warstwę wyżej, przy aplikacji i procesie jej dostarczania. Część zagadnień planujemy wspólnie z IT, dlatego cenimy zrozumienie również warstwy niższej. Szukamy osoby, która zadba o to, aby nasze rozwiązania można było sprawnie zbudować, wdrożyć i utrzymać w każdym środowisku, w którym pracują.

Do Twoich Zadań Będzie Należeć

rozwój i utrzymanie procesów CI/CD dla aplikacji w Javie, .NET i Node.js/TypeScripcie,
przygotowywanie obrazów kontenerów oraz pakowanie wdrożeń w Helm charty, wersjonowane dla poszczególnych środowisk i klientów,
wdrażanie aplikacji na klaster Kubernetes i konfiguracja warstwy kontenerowej, w tym zasobów, limitów i skalowania,
konfiguracja komponentów warstwy aplikacyjnej, na przykład serwerów aplikacyjnych i reverse proxy, oraz automatyzacja tych czynności w Ansible,
automatyzacja instalacji i aktualizacji produktu, również w środowiskach klientów,
konfiguracja i rozwój monitoringu, zbierania logów oraz alertowania,
rozbudowa pipeline’ów o bramki jakościowe: analizę SonarQube, testy automatyczne i skanowanie zależności,
zarządzanie konfiguracją i sekretami aplikacji w sposób bezpieczny dla środowisk produkcyjnych,
udział w projektowaniu rozwiązań: strategie wdrożeń bez przestoju, skalowalność, spójność środowisk deweloperskich, testowych i produkcyjnych,
wsparcie zespołów deweloperskich w diagnostyce problemów środowiskowych.

Wymagania

minimum 3 lata doświadczenia zawodowego w obszarze CI/CD i automatyzacji dostarczania oprogramowania,
praktyczna znajomość Dockera: budowanie i optymalizacja obrazów, sieci, wolumeny, diagnostyka,
doświadczenie w pracy z Kubernetesem w środowiskach produkcyjnych oraz umiejętność diagnozowania problemów z uruchamianiem i wydajnością aplikacji w klastrze,
znajomość Helma na poziomie tworzenia i utrzymania własnych chartów,
umiejętność pisania idempotentnych playbooków i ról w Ansible,
doświadczenie z Jenkinsem i GitHub Actions w modelu pipeline as code,
swobodna praca z Gitem i SonarQube w zespole deweloperskim,
znajomość narzędzi monitoringu i analizy logów; naszym standardem są Prometheus, Grafana oraz Loki lub Graylog,
dobra znajomość systemu Linux oraz umiejętność pisania skryptów w Bashu,
język angielski na poziomie co najmniej B2, ponieważ pracujemy w środowisku międzynarodowym.

Mile Widziane

znajomość Terraform, przynajmniej na poziomie czytania i rozumienia kodu; infrastrukturę planujemy wspólnie z działem IT,
znajomość jednego z języków, w których tworzymy nasze produkty: Javy, TypeScriptu lub .NET, w zakresie pozwalającym analizować kod aplikacji i jej wymagania uruchomieniowe,
doświadczenie z podejściem GitOps oraz narzędziami ArgoCD lub Flux,
doświadczenie operacyjne z bazami PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra lub Solr,
wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI w pracy inżynierskiej, w tym GitHub Copilot oraz rozwiązań opartych o modele językowe,
certyfikaty potwierdzające kompetencje w obszarze DevOps.

Oferujemy

Możliwość pracy hybrydowej - 2 dni w tygodniu z biura w Poznaniu na ul. Ratajczaka,
Pracę przy rozwoju produktów, a nie w obszarze utrzymania zgłoszeń,
Wpływ na kształt procesów CI/CD i standardy techniczne w zespołach produktowych,
Kontakt z kilkoma stosami technologicznymi w ramach jednej architektury,
Możliwość rozwoju w kierunku platform engineeringu, SRE lub architektury rozwiązań,
Pracę w zgranym, nastawionym na rozwój zespole, otwartym na nowe pomysły i dzielenie się wiedzą.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Service Delivery/IX Platform
jobs.description:
We are seeking an Engineer
to join our global IX Platform team, where innovation knows no borders. This role is part of a larger transition and a dedicated team being created in Kraków. This team designs, builds, and evolves modern cloud-native backend services and distributed architectures that power mission-critical travel and airline technology solutions worldwide. By delivering high-availability systems, robust APIs, and scalable data flows, the team enables travel disruptors and established leaders to retail, distribute, and fulfill travel at scale. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity, and commitment so we can all win together.

As an Engineer on the IX Platform team in Kraków, you will build and support resilient microservices, messaging patterns, and cloud-native backend components. You will collaborate across Product, Architecture, QA, SRE, and Delivery teams to translate platform vision into production-ready software. Takes ownership of services from design through implementation, deployment, and production support. This role demands strong backend engineering fundamentals, a commitment to clean code, and constructive problem-solving to maintain high reliability across enterprise distributed systems.

What You'll Do

Service Lifecycle: Take ownership of services from design through implementation, deployment, and production support.
Backend Engineering: Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance backend services using Java and modern JDK capabilities.
API Development: Build, consume, and document secure, well-structured RESTful and SOAP APIs and integration services for high-availability systems.
Cloud Operations: Deploy and operate containerized microservices in cloud environments, focusing on Google Cloud Platform, GKE, Cloud Run, and automated deployment patterns.
Distributed Systems: Implement asynchronous, event-driven communication patterns using messaging technologies, queues, and event streams.
Data Management: Optimize relational database schemas, SQL queries, transactions, caching mechanisms, and data access layers for consistency and scale.
Quality & Code Health: Author production-quality code with unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and drive continuous engineering improvements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to refine technical requirements, evaluate design trade-offs, and support operational readiness through logging, monitoring, and incident diagnostics.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Strong hands-on experience with Java backend development, modern JDK versions, JVM fundamentals, concurrency, and performance tuning.
Proven experience designing, developing, consuming, and maintaining REST and SOAP APIs, including API security, contracts, and versioning.
Practical experience with cloud-native architectures and containerization tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, or Google Cloud Platform services.
Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, microservices patterns, service discovery, resiliency, messaging systems (e.g., Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ), and key resilience/consistency mechanisms including retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, idempotency, consistency, latency, and failure handling.
Hands-on experience with relational databases, SQL schema design, query optimization, data modeling, and modern CI/CD practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or similar Java backend frameworks.
Hands-on experience with GCP-native services such as GKE, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace, or Cloud Build.
Experience with Kafka or high-volume event streaming platforms.
Experience designing systems for high availability, horizontal scaling, disaster recovery, and performance under load.
Experience with OpenAPI/Swagger, API gateways, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, enterprise identity integrations, or NoSQL/caching technologies like PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, Redis, or Elasticsearch.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Helm.
Domain experience in travel, airline, retailing, distribution, booking, or fulfillment enterprise systems.

Work arrangements

Hybrid working mode; 3 chosen days from the office in a week
Flexible working hours: Maintain your work-life balance by adjusting your working hours to your needs

Paid time off

Year-End-Break: enjoy additional fully paid days off during the last week of the year
Paid parental leave: Take up to 12 weeks off with pay after birth or adoption of a child. Sabre Global Paid Parental Leave runs concurrently with local leave policies.

Your money

Employee Capital Plans: profit from long-term saving scheme co-financed by Sabre and the State Treasury

Say Thanks program: collect points on recognition program and transfer them to wide variety of gifts and services

Foreign travel insurance: feel safe going abroad with free Allianz insurance offered as part of our Lux Med package
Employee Assistance Program: find help in free, confidential program with a certified counselor
Mindfulness & meditation apps: take care of your mental and physical health

Career development

Professional development: access to e-learning platforms as well as join Sabre live learning sessions
Certification and tuition reimbursement
Our Communities: join one of our team member groups focused on sharing knowledge and best practices (Google Developers Group, Innovation Lab Community, Women in Technology, SOLVE!T and many more)

And more

Company Description

Everyone's story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don't have to worry about it.

And there's more: We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable.

You’ll be part of a product team building and evolving reliable, scalable software in a modern engineering environment. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, cares about code quality, and wants to have a real impact on both our products and engineering practices.

Design, develop, test, and ship robust, maintainable, and readable software, applications, APIs, and workflows
Contribute to technical architecture design decisions
Work as part of an agile, cross-functional team and actively participat in Scrum ceremonies
Analyze, discuss, and implement business requirements while maintaining good documentation of the systems and components you create
Bring in industry standards and best practices to continually improve our codebase and architecture
Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organizational and industry standards and practices

5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with C# and .NET
Strong experience building and maintaining backend services
A solid understanding of RESTful APIs
Practical experience with data access patterns and ORMs, ideally Entity Framework
Good knowledge of relational databases, preferably SQL Server

Fluent English

jobs.title: Senior .NET utvecklare
jobs.description:
Att jobba som Senior .NET utvecklare

Vi söker en senior .NET utvecklare som vill bli en del av ett team som bygger och utvecklar affärskritiska system inom försäkringsområdet. Du kommer att arbeta nära mjukvaruarkitekter, produktägare, testare och andra utvecklare för att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla högkvalitativa lösningar som är säkra, skalbara och långsiktigt hållbara.

Tillsammans med teamet deltar du i arbete kring krav, design och systemarkitektur och bidrar till välgrundade tekniska beslut. Rollen har ett tydligt fokus på backendutveckling i .NET/C#, samtidigt som du även kommer att arbeta med och vidareutveckla interna frontendlösningar i React.

Utvecklingsarbetet sker i en eventdriven arkitektur inom en säkerhetskritisk miljö med stora datamängder och höga krav på tillförlitlighet, prestanda och stabilitet. Du arbetar med integrationer mot andra system och deltar aktivt i det kontinuerliga arbetet med att förbättra kodkvalitet, tekniska lösningar och teamets arbetssätt.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som är svensktalande och trivs i en utvecklarroll där kvalitet, säkerhet och driftsstabila system står i fokus. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med affärskritiska applikationer och känner dig trygg i att ta ägandeskap för tekniska lösningar genom hela utvecklingskedjan – från idé och design till implementation, vidareutveckling och optimering.

Du har ett strukturerat och analytiskt arbetssätt och uppskattar att samarbeta nära andra utvecklare i ett teamorienterat arbetssätt. Samtidigt delar du gärna med dig av din kompetens och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla både teamets arbetssätt och de tekniska plattformarna.

Vi tror också att du är nyfiken på ny teknik och intresserad av att ligga i framkant, exempelvis inom AI-stödd systemutveckling, och ser värdet i verktyg som GitHub Copilot för att skapa ännu bättre lösningar.

Vi Söker Dig Som Har Erfarenhet Av

Systemutveckling i C# och .NET
Backendutveckling och systemintegrationer
Eventdriven arkitektur eller meddelandebaserade lösningar, gärna NServiceBus eller RabbitMQ
Utveckling av RESTful API:er
Relationsdatabaser, gärna SQL Server, samt ORM-verktyg som EF Core
Git och moderna CI/CD-flöden

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Robert Blomqvist på robert.blomqvist@skandia.se

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Madelene Skogh på madelene.skogh@skandia.se

Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As part of a cross-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Qualifications

Who you are:

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.
Distributed systems: Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
Data fluency: Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Observability & troubleshooting: Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
Pragmatic tooling: Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.
Bonus points: Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.
