jobs.title: Senior .NET-utvecklare – API & tekniskt ledarskap
jobs.description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten

Vill du fortsätta vara hands-on i utvecklingen, men samtidigt få större möjlighet att påverka tekniska beslut och hur API-utvecklingen ska bedrivas?

Vi söker en senior .NET-utvecklare till ett mindre utvecklingsteam som arbetar med att modernisera en etablerad produkt (Lönessystemet POL). Fokus ligger på att utveckla API:er i C#/.NET med Kubernetes i en miljö där ny teknik möter befintlig arkitektur, kod och data.

Du kommer in i ett läge där det finns mycket att påverka. En del handlar om att bygga nytt, en annan om att förstå vad som redan finns och avgöra vad som ska behållas, förändras eller byggas om.

Teamet är litet och du kommer in som en nyckelperson från start. Med din seniora API-kompetens kliver du rakt in i de tekniska diskussionerna tillsammans med övriga seniora kollegor och får möjlighet att påverka både lösningar och vägval direkt. Här är det kort väg mellan idé och beslut och du får stort utrymme att förändra och förbättra. Du är samtidigt en del av det dagliga utvecklingsarbetet – det här är tekniskt ledarskap, inte personalansvar.

Vi använder givetvis AI som ett naturligt verktyg inom utvecklingen, men söker hela tiden nästa steg inom agentbaserad utveckling, som kan användas för att utveckla våra arbetssätt och lösningar.

Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du framför allt att:

Designa och utveckla moderna API:er i C#/.NET i en Kubernetes-baserad miljö.
Vara med och modernisera vår befintliga produkt med dess legacylösningar och göra tekniska vägval för hur de ska utvecklas vidare.
Ta ansvar för API-lösningen hela vägen från design och implementation men även vara djupt delaktig i hosting, CI/CD och deployment.
Vägleda andra utvecklare och vara ett stöd i tekniska diskussioner och vägval.
Ansvara för designfrågor kring bland annat idempotency, atomicity och concurrency.
Sätta dig in i befintlig kod, datamodeller och stored procedures och bedöma vad som kan återanvändas och vad som behöver förändras.
Samarbeta med DevOps- och infrastrukturkompetenser kring drift och deployment.
Bidra till och driva utvecklingen av teamets arbetssätt, bland annat inom AI och agentbaserad utveckling.

Vi tror på värdet av att träffas och arbeta tillsammans på plats. Det skapar både ett effektivt arbetssätt och ett nära samarbete i teamet. Därför ser vi gärna att du är på vårt kontor i Solna 2–3 dagar i veckan.

Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll

Vi söker dig som är en erfaren utvecklare och som är van att arbeta med API:er i komplexa systemmiljöer. För den här rollen är det särskilt viktigt att du har erfarenhet av API:er som skapar och uppdaterar verksamhetskritiska data.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

Mycket god erfarenhet av C#/.NET och API-utveckling, inklusive design och implementation av API:er för create- och update-operationer.
God förståelse för robust API-design, exempelvis concurrency, idempotency, retries, atomicity, transaktioner och datakonsistens.
Erfarenhet av lösningar där flera beroende databasändringar behöver genomföras tillsammans eller rullas tillbaka vid fel.
Erfarenhet av att integrera moderna API-lösningar med legacysystem och bedöma vad som kan återanvändas, behöver refaktoreras eller byggas om.
Förståelse för API:ets hela livscykel, inklusive containers, hosting, CI/CD och deployment.
Förmåga att göra välgrundade tekniska och arkitekturella vägval och förankra dem i teamet.
Förmåga att ta tekniskt ansvar och vägleda andra utvecklare, samtidigt som du själv arbetar hands-on.
Svenska i tal och skrift på professionell nivå.

Det är mycket meriterande om du har praktisk erfarenhet av Kubernetes och är van att deploya och drifta containeriserade applikationer. Erfarenhet av exempelvis Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, kubectl, YAML och Helm är särskilt relevant för vår miljö.

Erfarenhet av Azure, tekniskt arkitekturarbete, API- och applikationssäkerhet eller AI-assisterad/agentbaserad utveckling är meriterande.

Eftersom vi är ett litet team lägger vi stor vikt vid hur du fungerar tillsammans med andra. Vi söker dig som delar med dig av det du kan och samtidigt är öppen för andras perspektiv. Du kan stå för dina tekniska bedömningar och vågar ifrågasätta när du ser en bättre väg, utan att tappa samarbetet på vägen. Du tar ansvar för det du driver och är bekväm med att ta reda på vad som behövs när allt inte är färdigdefinierat.

Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning.

Om du har några frågor eller funderingar, kontakta gärna rekryterade chef Carl Gerhardsson via mail carl.gerhardsson@cgi.com

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.

Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.

Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.

Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.

Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.

Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

jobs.title: Salesforce Solution Architect
jobs.description:
At Polestar, you will have the opportunity to influence the future architecture of one of our most strategic commercial platforms, working at the intersection of customer experience, business transformation, and modern digital engineering.

The opportunity

Polestar is accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through electric performance. Digital Commercial plays a critical role in enabling customer growth, customer experience, sales, fleet and retailer operations, digital channels, and commercial excellence across all markets.

Salesforce is a strategic platform within Polestar's digital landscape, supporting customer engagement, sales, fleet operations, customer service, marketing, portals, AI-enabled experiences, and critical integrations with enterprise platforms such as ERP, integration platforms, data platforms, and other digital products.

As our business continues to evolve, we are strengthening our internal architecture capability and establishing clearer architectural ownership, standards, and governance across the Salesforce ecosystem. This role will help define the future direction of the platform, ensuring solutions remain scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with Polestar's enterprise architecture.

This position is located at Gothenburg, Sweden. We believe in a hybrid model when it comes to remote and onsite work, knowing that both in-person collaboration and individual time to focus are needed. What matters most is that people get the time, and support, to do what needs to be done. And to enjoy doing it, of course.

Let us describe the challenge we offer

As a Salesforce Solution Architect, you will provide architectural leadership across Polestar's Salesforce landscape, spanning Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce, customer portals, fleet solutions, and related integrations. You will work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, engineers, enterprise architects, and external partners to ensure that solutions are aligned with both business objectives and long-term technology strategy.

The role requires balancing customer experience, business process efficiency, integration complexity, security requirements, and platform sustainability. You will help teams make the right architectural decisions while reducing technical debt, increasing reuse, and enabling faster delivery across multiple products and markets. You will be a key contributor in defining platform guardrails, integration patterns, data ownership principles, and future-state architecture for one of Polestar's most business-critical platforms.

What You'll Do

You will lead solution architecture across multiple initiatives and help shape the evolution of Polestar's Salesforce ecosystem.

See below for a more thorough breakdown of the various tasks and areas you'll be responsible for:

Designing scalable Salesforce solutions across customer, sales, service, fleet, and commercial domains
Leading solution architecture for strategic Salesforce initiatives and programmes
Defining architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails for Salesforce development
Ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and technology standards
Driving integration architecture across Salesforce, AWS, ERP systems, customer identity, data platforms, and digital products
Defining data ownership, master data, and information flow principles
Supporting product teams in architecture decisions, technical design, and solution governance
Ensuring solutions meet security, privacy, compliance, and audit requirements
Managing cross-team dependencies and reducing solution complexity
Driving platform scalability, maintainability, and operational excellence
Supporting roadmap planning and target architecture definition
Contributing to architecture reviews and governance forums
Mentoring engineers and supporting the broader architecture community

In your daily work, you will collaborate with teams across CRM, Customer Experience, Sales, Fleet, Marketing, Customer Care, Data & AI, Enterprise Architecture, and Digital Commercial leadership. You will also work closely with enterprise architects, chief architects, solution architects, product teams, and strategic partners.

Who You Are

You are comfortable navigating complex business domains and translating business needs into practical and sustainable Salesforce solutions. You can balance strategic thinking with hands-on architecture work and enjoy collaborating across business and technology teams. You have strong communication skills and can explain architectural concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. You understand that great architecture is not just about technology. It is about enabling business outcomes while maintaining simplicity, governance, and long-term sustainability.

To be a great fit for this position, we believe you have:

Minimum 5 years of experience as a Solution Architect, Salesforce Architect, or Lead Salesforce Consultant
Deep knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities and architecture patterns
Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Salesforce integrations
Experience designing APIs, event-driven integrations, and distributed solutions
Strong understanding of customer data management and enterprise integration patterns
Experience working with cloud-native architectures and modern development practices
Knowledge of security, privacy, identity, and compliance requirements
Experience working in agile product organisations
Ability to lead architecture across multiple teams and business domains

The Following Would Be Considered An Advantage

Salesforce certifications such as Application Architect, System Architect, or Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
Experience with Marketing Cloud or Agentforce
Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP, customer identity, and enterprise data platforms
Experience within automotive, retail, mobility, or direct-to-consumer digital businesses

Polestar is an international company, with various backgrounds represented. English, therefore, is the language of written and spoken communication. And though we have a global presence, we maintain the growth-mindset. Change happens often at Polestar. But so does progress. Expect an accelerating, exciting environment.

Is this you?

If the above matches your ambitions, be sure to apply. Our selection process is ongoing, and the job advert will remain open until it's filled.

The Polestar journey is an electric one.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About The Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.

Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.

Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.

You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.

You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

At Susquehanna Sports we specialize in geopolitical and sports analytics across the globe. This is an opportunity to build out a next gen sports trading system within an early-stage initiative focused on influential product development.

Technology is at the forefront of everything we do, requiring cutting-edge and innovative technology expertise. Our technologists at Susquehanna Sports enjoy working on highly complex in-house software that runs on the most modern platforms available, solving a wide range of problems to help us grow. We're backed by our industry leading trading business and we’re introducing an initiative that will revolutionize the industry. Our people continue to grow and learn throughout their careers as market demands change the nature of our environment, thanks to our flat structure and collaborative environment.

Join us and be part of a collaborative team that values continuous learning and growth. Are you passionate about sports wagering and trading? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where innovation is at the forefront? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!

What You’ll Do

You will play a crucial role in designing, coding, and maintaining our next gen analysis and trading platform. You will work closely with Quantitative Researchers and other developers to:

Design and architect complex systems and software solutions from scratch.
Build out an order sending system that will allow us to trade at scale, in many sports leagues across multiple exchanges.
Develop and Design high performance streaming systems.
Integrate reference file and streaming data feeds from multiple vendors.
Develop data recording and price evaluation tools.
Deliver interactive presentations for business users and stakeholders.
Participate in the full software development life cycle, including building, testing and production deployment.

What We're Looking For

Experience: Proven success in server-side software development, system design and technical event-driven architecture. Consistent career progression in the development of data focused, high performance streaming systems.
Skills: Strong proficiency in C# with previous Python experience and a solid understanding of Agile development methodologies. Experience with Kafka, Kubernetes and Cloud Computing is highly desired.
Education: MS/BS Degree in Computer Science or a related STEM field or equivalent practical experience at the senior level.
Interests: A keen interest in sports wagering, trading, and technology. Previous experience working within Trading, Sports Analytics or Sports Wagering industries is highly preferred.
Attributes: Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to adapt to changing priorities. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Why Join Us?

Innovative Environment: Work on a mixture of highly complex in-house software using the latest platforms.
Growth Opportunities: Continuous learning and career development in a flat, collaborative structure.
Mentorship: Work with industry veterans and technical experts who are passionate about mentoring and sharing their knowledge.
Perks: Excellent salary, benefits, and opportunities to attend world sporting events.
Team: Join a small but growing team of skilled and passionate researchers, quants, and developers.

About Susquehanna

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm founded by a group of friends who share a passion for game theory and probabilistic thinking. We have incorporated this approach into our culture, where you will find relentless problem solvers within each of our core disciplines: Trading, Technology, and Quantitative Research. From offices around the world, our employees collaborate to make optimal decisions and are driven by the desire to achieve winning results together.

We are experts in trading essentially all listed financial products and asset classes, with a focus on derivatives trading. Through market making and market taking, we handle millions of trading transactions around the world every day, providing liquidity and ensuring competitive prices for buyers and sellers. While our presence in the market is broad, our trading desks are highly specialized, allowing for a deep understanding of unique drivers of each asset class.

jobs.description:
Position Description

De beste CRM-løsningene starter ikke med en funksjonsliste. De starter med å forstå hva som skal fungere bedre for kunden.

CGI søker flere kolleger til vårt Microsoft-miljø i Oslo. Vi ser etter deg som har praktisk erfaring med Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement og/eller Power Platform, og som liker å gjøre kundebehov om til løsninger som faktisk blir brukt.

Kanskje trives du best med kundedialog, workshops, prosesser og konfigurasjon. Kanskje foretrekker du Dataverse, integrasjoner, utvikling og teknisk løsningsdesign. Eller kanskje du er personen som får forretning og teknologi til å forstå hverandre.

Vi er ikke på jakt etter én person som kan alt. Vi skal ansette flere og ønsker kolleger med ulike og utfyllende styrker.

Dette kan du jobbe med:

Som konsulent hos CGI vil du jobbe tett med kunder og kolleger gjennom hele eller deler av leveransen – fra de første behovene til løsningen er tatt i bruk.

Avhengig av erfaring og interesse kan du blant annet:

Kartlegge behov og lede workshops med kunder og brukere
Rådgi kunder om CRM, kundeprosesser og bruk av Microsoft-plattformen
Konfigurere og videreutvikle Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service og andre relevante løsninger
Bygge apper, automatiseringer og brukerflater med Power Apps, Power Automate og Power Pages
Utforme datamodeller og løsninger i Dataverse
Arbeide med integrasjoner, API-er, Azure-tjenester og teknisk arkitektur
Bidra med testing, migrering, dokumentasjon, opplæring og innføring
Se forbedringsmuligheter og hjelpe kundene med å ta gode valg videre

Du vil samarbeide med funksjonelle konsulenter, utviklere, arkitekter og rådgivere. Hos oss skal du både kunne fordype deg i ditt eget fagområde og lære av kolleger med en annen bakgrunn enn deg selv.

Hvilken profil kjenner du deg mest igjen i?

Den funksjonelle konsulenten

Du liker å forstå hvordan kunden arbeider i dag, hva som bør bli bedre, og hvordan teknologien kan støtte dette. Du har gjerne erfaring med behovskartlegging, prosessarbeid, konfigurasjon, krav, workshops, opplæring eller innføring av nye løsninger.

Den tekniske konsulenten

Du liker å bygge, integrere og forbedre løsninger. Du kan ha erfaring med Dataverse, Power Platform, Azure, API-er, integrasjoner, løsningsarkitektur, ALM eller utvikling i C#, JavaScript eller TypeScript.

Brobyggeren

Du forstår både forretningsbehovene og de tekniske mulighetene. Du kan diskutere prosesser med kunden, samarbeide med utviklere og forklare tekniske valg på en forståelig måte.

Mange kombinerer elementer fra flere av disse profilene. Du trenger ikke å plassere deg i bare én kategori.

Dette mener vi bør være på plass

Vi ser først og fremst etter deg som:

jobs.title: Software Engineer🚗
jobs.description:
Om oss 🚗

Siden starten i 2017 har Nettbil gjort bilsalg enklere og tryggere for privatpersoner ved å la flere bilforhandlere konkurrere om samme bil. Over 100 000 biler er solgt gjennom plattformen vår, til mer enn 2 000 forhandlere.

Vi er en del av Vend, den største markedsplass-operatøren i Norden. Med fokus på å utnytte teknologi og forbedre brukeropplevelsen, er Nettbil et av de mest spennende vekstselskapene i Norge. Hos oss er kultur nøkkelen: vi jobber sammen, vi er sultne på å lykkes, og vi jobber for å finne smarte løsninger.

Om rollen 🧑‍💻

Bak det som for kundene virker friksjonsfritt, ligger et kraftfullt maskineri. Vi gjør handelen enkel for begge parter: bileieren som skal selge, og forhandleren som skal kjøpe. Når en bil legges ut, byr forhandlerne på den i sanntid. Alt som skjer under budrunden må stemme.

Nettbil vokser, og teknologiorganisasjonen bygges ut i flere team med egne ansvarsområder. Vi er godt i gang med et moderniseringsløft der vi fornyer arkitekturen for enda mer vekst, og mange av valgene står fortsatt åpne. Du kommer inn mens det ennå er mye å ta stilling til.

Som Software Engineer vil du blant annet:

Videreutvikle auksjonsplattformen vår (hjertet av Nettbil!) som håndterer over 2 000 bilsalg hver måned
Bygge flatene bileiere og forhandlere møter oss gjennom, fra første prisestimat til gjennomført salg
Utforske hvordan AI og maskinlæring kan skape nye muligheter, fra automatiserte prosesser til systemer som oppdager avvik før de rekker å bli problemer
Gjøre modellene bak prisestimatene våre stadig mer treffsikre
Jobbe med integrasjoner mot eksterne aktører
Samarbeide tett med produktledere, designere, analytikere og andre utviklere
Løfte håndverket vårt, slik at teknologien aldri blir det som bremser oss

Ettersom vi er i sterk vekst ansetter vi flere, på ulike nivåer. Nøyaktig hva du jobber med, avhenger av hva du kan og hva du vil bli bedre på.

Hvem er du? 🌟

Du har stått i problemer uten opplagte svar, og vil vite hvorfor vi løser noe før du går i gang. Du bryr deg om koden din, også etter at PR-en er merget og i produksjon. Du utfordrer måten ting gjøres på, selv når den fungerer. Du ser noe nytt og lurer på hva vi kunne brukt det til. Du deler det du kan, og spør når du lurer.

Vi ser etter deg som:

Har jobbet som utvikler
Har relevant utdanning eller tilsvarende bakgrunn
Behersker norsk som arbeidsspråk
Kan møte opp på kontoret vårt på Økern

Teknologistacken vår 🚦

Det er ikke nødvendig å være ekspert på hele stacken vår; det viktigste er en solid forståelse av grunnleggende utviklingsprinsipper og gode tekniske ferdigheter. Dette er noe av det du kan forvente hos Nettbil:

Språk: TypeScript
Frontend: React Router, TanStack Query, Tailwind
Backend: Node.js
Databaser: PostgreSQL, MySQL
Infrastruktur: AWS, Kubernetes, OpenTofu
Køer: BullMQ
Testing: Cypress, Vitest

Vi har også teknologi utenfor listen over. Blant annet forvaltes innholdet vårt i Sanity (med Next.js), og til analyse og maskinlæring bruker vi Redshift og SageMaker, med innslag av språk som Python og Go. Datadog gir oss observerbarhet på tvers av tjenestene.

Hva vi kan tilby deg🌞

Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø preget av samarbeid, høy faglig kompetanse og felles ambisjoner.
Scale‑up med trygghet: del av Vend‑konsernet med støtte i ryggen og langsiktig satsing, kombinert med farten til en scale-up
Høy tillit, korte beslutningsveier og stor frihet i hvordan du løser oppgaver
Moderne kontorlokaler på Økern Portal med treningssenter, takterrasse og flere lunsjsteder.
Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling

Hos Nettbil blir du en del av et sammensveiset og engasjert miljø med rundt 100 kollegaer. Vi tror de beste løsningene skapes når mennesker med ulike erfaringer og perspektiver samarbeider, og legger derfor stor vekt på kunnskapsdeling, samarbeid og utvikling.

Vi holder til i toppetasjen på Økern Portal med utsikt over hele Oslo, takterasse, treningssenteret i bygget og flere gode lunsjsteder. Det er likevel menneskene som gjør arbeidsplassen vår spesiell. Vi har en kultur med lav terskel for å dele ideer, hjelpe hverandre og feire små og store milepæler. Enten det er sommerfest, felles lunsjer, sosiale samlinger, ønsker vi å skape en ambisiøs arbeidsplass der det er både meningsfylt og hyggelig å være.

Slik søker du 🧰

Send oss CV og noen ord om deg selv og hva som motiverer deg for rollen. Søknader vurderes fortløpende. Har du spørsmål om stillingen eller ønsker en uforpliktende prat, er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med Martine Grønlund på martine.gronlund@nettbil.no.

⭐
Vi er stolte av tilliten kundene våre viser oss. Les gjerne hva kundene våre sier om oss på Trustpilot: no.trustpilot.com/review/nettbil.no

Nettbil ble lansert i 2017 fordi vi synes salg av bil burde gjøres enklere og bedre for folk. Vi hadde et ønske om å lage en løsning hvor flere forhandlere kunne by på bil samtidig. Nettbil har siden den gang blitt en digital tjeneste for bilsalg, hvor vi gjør hele jobben for deg.

Nettbil eies av Vend, den største markedsplassoperatøren i Norden. Med fokus på å utnytte teknologi og forbedre brukeropplevelsen, er Nettbil et av de mest spennende vekstselskapene i Norge.

Vi er stolte over å ha hjulpet over 105 000 kunder med å selge bilen sin, og at vi nå har over 2 000 bilforhandlere fra hele landet som kan bli med i budrunden!

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US  

As our new Senior Software Engineer, you will join SimCorp's Product Division, in the Platform Automation department. Here, you will join a cross-functional agile team based in Copenhagen, Kyiv and Manila. Your team is responsible for building a continuous delivery pipeline for our core products in Cloud and you will be working in close co-operation with your colleagues across different locations. You will provide input into our technical vision and direction. We value good craftsmanship.

Your team owns the SimCorp Dimension (SCD) Delivery Pipeline. A platform for end-to-end automation that enables the development, testing, and release of consistent product versions at scale. This is your opportunity to make a tangible impact on how SimCorp delivers software to clients worldwide, working on tooling and infrastructure that directly supports hundreds of engineers across the organisation.

Ensure code quality and technical excellence. Research tools and frameworks to enable future innovation.
Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, and apply this knowledge to improve our solutions and practices.

Experience working in an international setting with people from many different cultures 
Constructive and positive mindset: you help foster an environment where the team can collaborate openly and do its best work
You care about your team and care about having an enjoyable working environment 
Excellent communication skills and fluency in English (speaking and writing) 

Technical Skills That We Are Looking For

Experience working with software development using one or more modern programming languages (We mostly use C#).
Experience implementing Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
Build Automation: Experience with build automation tools and practices.

Our Tech stack :

Claude and Copilot

Experience in guiding junior developers and providing technical guidance.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effectively interacting with team members, stakeholders, and clients.
Ability to clearly convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to identify issues, take ownership and develop effective solutions.
Experience working in agile development environments.

DESIRABLE

Performance Optimization - Skills in optimizing code and systems for performance and scalability.
Documentation - Ability to create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation.
Desirable technology experience: Kubernetes, Docker, Elastic Search, C#, Terraform/Bicep.

Benefits

We offer a competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension — essentials for any work agreement. But at SimCorp, we believe in offering more. In addition to a traditional benefits package, we provide excellent work-life balance through flexible work hours and a hybrid workplace model.

We also offer IP sprints — three weeks per quarter dedicated to mastering your skills and contributing innovative ideas to company development.

There is never just one path — we take an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering - Conferences Technology
jobs.description:
About Gartner IT:

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.

About the Role:

Gartner is seeking a Director of Software Engineering to lead the design, development, and operation of our conference attendee-facing mobile and web platforms. These enterprise-grade solutions are essential to delivering a seamless, intuitive experience at every stage of the conference journey for our attendees—senior and executive leaders from across industries who expect the highest standards of reliability, innovation, and convenience.

As Director, you will wear three hats:

Strategic Leader: Align initiatives with business goals, translating vision into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
Team Architect: Define roles, decision rights, and structures for empowered, autonomous delivery teams.
Capability Builder: Develop talent, implement targeted training, and foster distributed leadership for a resilient, high-performing organization.

This high-visibility position bridges technical execution and business outcomes. The Director will travel up to 30 days per year, providing technical leadership and on-site support at 4 to 5 platinum Gartner conferences.

Key Responsibilities

Product Delivery Leadership

Lead end-to-end delivery for attendee-facing mobile and web platforms, overseeing architecture, roadmap prioritization, and quality assurance.
Ensure timely, high-quality releases aligned with conference calendars and business goals, supporting a discerning user base of senior and executive leaders.
Partner with Business stakeholders to define and communicate product strategy, translating technical capabilities (scalability, personalization, analytics, mobile-first design) into impactful business outcomes.
Set and track clear, measurable success metrics for platform performance, user satisfaction, and operational excellence.
Continuously evaluate and integrate emerging technologies (AI, advanced analytics, personalization engines, modern frameworks) to enhance customer journeys and digital engagement.

Team Leadership and Development

Build and empower a high-performing engineering team through recruiting, coaching, and developing both managers and individual contributors.
Foster an inclusive, accountable, and growth-oriented culture with clear communication and mentoring.
Distribute leadership and decision-making, defining autonomous ownership areas and escalation paths.
Expose engineers to real attendee needs and conference economics, building business acumen and a strong sense of purpose.

Product Ownership and Portfolio Alignment

Partner with Business and technology stakeholders to define clear product ownership boundaries.
Align teams to business outcomes, connecting platform capabilities to strategic priorities.
Structure teams for autonomy and end-to-end delivery, minimizing handoffs and dependency bottlenecks.

Governance & Cross-Functional Coordination

Partner with Product and Program Directors, and Implement work visibility mechanisms across product, program, and platform levels.
Clarify decision-making levels and shift accountability from activity to outcomes—focusing on delivery pace, quality, and user satisfaction.
Build relationships across product management, event operations, marketing, and data teams to align delivery with organizational goals.
Communicate platform strategy and progress to senior leadership, translating technical complexity into business impact.

Qualifications & Experience

12+ years in software engineering, with at least 4–5 years in engineering leadership.
3+ years leading teams of 15+ engineers or managing large-scale product delivery.
Proven experience with high-scale or mission-critical external facing mobile and web platforms where reliability, performance, and scalability directly impact business outcomes.
Strong experience designing digital products using .NET (Preferred)/ Python /Java and deploying on cloud providers such as AWS (preferred), Azure
Strong track record delivering products on fixed timelines with cross-functional dependencies.
Deep knowledge of scalable system architecture, modern development practices, and emerging technologies.
Excellent communication, executive presence, and stakeholder management skills.
Willingness and ability to travel up to 30 days per year to provide technical leadership at major Gartner conferences.

Why Join Gartner?

Be at the forefront of digital event experiences, leading a talented team to deliver innovative solutions for industry leaders. Shape the future of our platforms, drive measurable business impact, and grow your career in a dynamic, supportive environment.

What you will get:

Competitive compensation
25 days annual holiday and an additional day off for your birthday.
Private Medical and Dental Care.
Life and Disability Insurance.
Public Transport Subsidy.
Ticket Restaurant Card.
Childcare Vouchers (Ticket Guarderia).
IncentiFit - annual reimbursement for health-and-wellness-related activities.
Pension Scheme.
Tuition Reimbursement.
Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
Employee Assistance Program.
Gartner Gives Charity Match.
Relocation Assistance - a specialist to help you with all the appointments and paperwork.
Limitless growth and learning opportunities.
A collaborative and positive culture - join a diverse team of professionals that are as smart and driven as you.
A chance to make an impact – your work will contribute directly to our strategy.
Hybrid Work Environment - enjoy the flexibility of working from home and the energy of collaborating with peers in our dynamic offices.
New offices close to Glòries and the beach in the fantastic, “innovation and tech” 22@ district of sunny Barcelona.
Fresh fruit, snacks, selection of teas, fair trade organic coffee.

And much more!

Please Note:

Applications must be submitted in English.
A valid EU visa/passport is required for this position.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Here’s a summary of the role:

As a Staff Ruby on Rails Engineer at Diligent, you will set technical direction for secure, scalable, and high-performing SaaS applications and services that power our governance platform. This role is ideal for you if you thrive on solving the hardest technical problems, shaping architecture across multiple teams, and driving how the organization builds software — including how we responsibly adopt AI into our engineering practices and products.

You will own critical systems end-to-end, partner closely with Product, Security, DevOps, and other engineering leaders to shape technical roadmaps, and mentor engineers across the department. A key part of this role is helping define our AI strategy: embedding AI responsibly into our systems and workflows, advising on where AI tools and capabilities can meaningfully improve delivery, and raising the bar on how the team uses them safely and effectively.

Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff):

Champion the design, delivery, and evolution of secure, scalable Ruby on Rails applications and services, driving architecture decisions across multiple teams and codebases, with responsibility for scalability, reliability, and the underlying infrastructure required to run them effectively.
Set technical direction for major projects and platform initiatives, from solution design and prototyping through implementation and production ownership. Own and evolve the technical roadmap by identifying, shaping, and driving new technical initiatives and investments.
Develop and evolve web applications and services with a strong focus on scalability, maintainability, reliability, and long-term platform health.
Identify systemic pain points across services and propose pragmatic architectural improvements, including decomposition of monoliths and evolution toward service-oriented or microservices patterns where it adds value.
Partner effectively with Product, QA, Security, and other engineering leaders to shape technical roadmaps, ensure compliance, and deliver working software into production. Help teams move forward by resolving technical ambiguity, identifying cross-team dependencies, and providing clear technical direction where needed.
Pioneer and enable the responsible use of AI in engineering workflows — advising on where AI-assisted coding, debugging, prototyping, and other AI capabilities improve speed or quality, and helping teams adopt them with appropriate human validation, monitoring, and governance.
Champion code quality through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing, documentation, and continuous improvement of engineering practices across teams.
Mentor engineers at all levels, share knowledge broadly, and help raise the bar on technical execution, delivery discipline, architectural thinking, and AI-augmented ways of working.
Continuously evaluate and pilot new tools and technologies — including AI toolchains — optimizing for scalability, reliability, performance, cost efficiency, and developer productivity.

These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview:

8+ years of professional software engineering experience in a commercial software environment, with deep hands-on experience building and scaling web applications and services.
Expert-level understanding of Ruby on Rails and a strong track record delivering production-grade backend or full-stack applications with it at scale.
Extensive experience with API and web development, including RESTful service design, and proven ability to design and review scalable, high-performance system architectures, APIs, and data models.
Demonstrated experience designing secure software in environments that embrace DevOps, infrastructure as code, and automated delivery practices.
Deep understanding of microservices or service-oriented architectures and the trade-offs involved in distributed systems, with experience guiding these decisions across teams.
Practical understanding of AI model capabilities, prompt engineering, and responsible/safe AI use, with the ability to advise on and help shape AI strategy and embed monitoring or governance into engineering workflows.
Strong experience with source control systems such as Git and GitHub, along with collaborative and branching workflows at scale.
Excellent communication skills, with proven ability to influence technical direction, lead cross-functional initiatives, and explain technical and AI-related concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to mentor engineers, set engineering standards, and break down large, ambiguous initiatives into executable work across teams.
Strong knowledge of SQL and data modeling, with the ability to reason about application performance, persistence-layer design, and capacity planning at scale.
Experience working with AWS-based systems, serverless architectures, and modern cloud deployment and migration patterns.

Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly - those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. new_jobs.description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering
is the team that builds and supports the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences
. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About The Role

We’re looking for a product-focused Software Engineer II
to join our fast-growing Experiences Engineering team. This is a full-stack role, leveraging Java, SQL, React, AWS and AI tools
. It’s ideal for mid-level engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, shipping frequently, and working in a modern cloud environment. You’ll play a key role in building high-impact features that power millions of traveler experiences globally.

We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model
with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally up to 1.5 hours) of one of our office hubs in Oxford.

What You’ll Do

Drive Impact: Connect your engineering work directly to traveler value by owning features from design to deployment.
Shape the Product: Partner with product, design, and data teams to influence what we build, helping to define specifications and find the most efficient path to success.
Collaborate & Mentor: Review code, provide thoughtful feedback, and coach less experienced engineers to maintain a high bar for quality.
Innovate with AI: Use agentic AI as a daily partner to plan approaches, automate routine tasks, and focus your energy on solving more complex technical challenges.
Champion Operational Health: Take hands-on ownership of system reliability by building monitoring dashboards, managing alerts and support cases, and fixing underlying bugs to continuously improve service resilience and eliminate operational toil.
Build for Quality: Design and implement clean, maintainable solutions with a focus on performance, security, and automated testing.

Skills & Experience

We typically look for a minimum of 2-3 years’ experience, following a Bachelor’s degree or above in Comp Science or a related field.

Full-Stack Mindset: Experience developing web apps, including proficiency in a modern backend language (e.g., Java, C#, Go, Python) and familiarity with relational databases.
Problem Solving: A strong grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and the ability to apply them to real-world distributed systems.
Data-Driven: A habit of using operational data and experiment results to validate that your changes had the intended effect.
AI Coding: you are fluent coding with either Cursor or Codex/Claude/Open Code.
Global Mindset: Ability to operate effectively within a global team, communicating clearly about progress and blockers.

We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. However, we’re especially interested if you’ve had exposure to AWS, React, or NoSQL databases. More than any specific tool, we value curiosity and the ability to solve problems creatively.

We value engineers from different technical backgrounds. You can complete our coding interview exercises
in any language of your choice, but need to be open to working within the Java ecosystem when you join!

What We Offer

Competitive compensation packages, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.
“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations.
Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveller first: We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.
Execution is our edge: We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.
We succeed together: The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

Discover more in our Tech Blog, for an inside look into some of our exciting and ground-breaking technical projects here at Tripadvisor Group.

Tripadvisor Group champions the unique identities, abilities, and experiences of all our people – employees, customers, and partners. This stems from our belief in the transformative power of travel, dining, and experiences to connect us and open doors to worlds very different from our own. Our ED&I strategy shapes how we approach our people, culture, business, and reputation. Tripadvisor Group strives to embed inclusion and belonging across all our brands.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com
.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com
. We have all the answers!

This team designs, builds, and evolves modern cloud-native backend services and distributed architectures that power mission-critical travel and airline technology solutions worldwide. By delivering high-availability systems, robust APIs, and scalable data flows, the team enables travel disruptors and established leaders to retail, distribute, and fulfill travel at scale. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity, and commitment so we can all win together.

As an Engineer on the IX Platform team in Kraków, you will build and support resilient microservices, messaging patterns, and cloud-native backend components. You will collaborate across Product, Architecture, QA, SRE, and Delivery teams to translate platform vision into production-ready software. Takes ownership of services from design through implementation, deployment, and production support. This role demands strong backend engineering fundamentals, a commitment to clean code, and constructive problem-solving to maintain high reliability across enterprise distributed systems.

What You'll Do

Service Lifecycle: Take ownership of services from design through implementation, deployment, and production support.
Backend Engineering: Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance backend services using Java and modern JDK capabilities.
API Development: Build, consume, and document secure, well-structured RESTful and SOAP APIs and integration services for high-availability systems.
Cloud Operations: Deploy and operate containerized microservices in cloud environments, focusing on Google Cloud Platform, GKE, Cloud Run, and automated deployment patterns.
Distributed Systems: Implement asynchronous, event-driven communication patterns using messaging technologies, queues, and event streams.
Data Management: Optimize relational database schemas, SQL queries, transactions, caching mechanisms, and data access layers for consistency and scale.
Quality & Code Health: Author production-quality code with unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and drive continuous engineering improvements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to refine technical requirements, evaluate design trade-offs, and support operational readiness through logging, monitoring, and incident diagnostics.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Strong hands-on experience with Java backend development, modern JDK versions, JVM fundamentals, concurrency, and performance tuning.
Proven experience designing, developing, consuming, and maintaining REST and SOAP APIs, including API security, contracts, and versioning.
Practical experience with cloud-native architectures and containerization tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, or Google Cloud Platform services.
Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, microservices patterns, service discovery, resiliency, messaging systems (e.g., Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ), and key resilience/consistency mechanisms including retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, idempotency, consistency, latency, and failure handling.
Hands-on experience with relational databases, SQL schema design, query optimization, data modeling, and modern CI/CD practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or similar Java backend frameworks.
Hands-on experience with GCP-native services such as GKE, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace, or Cloud Build.
Experience with Kafka or high-volume event streaming platforms.
Experience designing systems for high availability, horizontal scaling, disaster recovery, and performance under load.
Experience with OpenAPI/Swagger, API gateways, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, enterprise identity integrations, or NoSQL/caching technologies like PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, Redis, or Elasticsearch.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Helm.
Domain experience in travel, airline, retailing, distribution, booking, or fulfillment enterprise systems.

Work arrangements

Paid time off

new_jobs.title: Senior .NET utvecklare
new_jobs.description:
Att jobba som Senior .NET utvecklare

Vi söker en senior .NET utvecklare som vill bli en del av ett team som bygger och utvecklar affärskritiska system inom försäkringsområdet. Du kommer att arbeta nära mjukvaruarkitekter, produktägare, testare och andra utvecklare för att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla högkvalitativa lösningar som är säkra, skalbara och långsiktigt hållbara.

Tillsammans med teamet deltar du i arbete kring krav, design och systemarkitektur och bidrar till välgrundade tekniska beslut. Rollen har ett tydligt fokus på backendutveckling i .NET/C#, samtidigt som du även kommer att arbeta med och vidareutveckla interna frontendlösningar i React.

Utvecklingsarbetet sker i en eventdriven arkitektur inom en säkerhetskritisk miljö med stora datamängder och höga krav på tillförlitlighet, prestanda och stabilitet. Du arbetar med integrationer mot andra system och deltar aktivt i det kontinuerliga arbetet med att förbättra kodkvalitet, tekniska lösningar och teamets arbetssätt.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som är svensktalande och trivs i en utvecklarroll där kvalitet, säkerhet och driftsstabila system står i fokus. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med affärskritiska applikationer och känner dig trygg i att ta ägandeskap för tekniska lösningar genom hela utvecklingskedjan – från idé och design till implementation, vidareutveckling och optimering.

Du har ett strukturerat och analytiskt arbetssätt och uppskattar att samarbeta nära andra utvecklare i ett teamorienterat arbetssätt. Samtidigt delar du gärna med dig av din kompetens och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla både teamets arbetssätt och de tekniska plattformarna.

Vi tror också att du är nyfiken på ny teknik och intresserad av att ligga i framkant, exempelvis inom AI-stödd systemutveckling, och ser värdet i verktyg som GitHub Copilot för att skapa ännu bättre lösningar.

Vi Söker Dig Som Har Erfarenhet Av

Systemutveckling i C# och .NET
Backendutveckling och systemintegrationer
Eventdriven arkitektur eller meddelandebaserade lösningar, gärna NServiceBus eller RabbitMQ
Utveckling av RESTful API:er
Relationsdatabaser, gärna SQL Server, samt ORM-verktyg som EF Core
Git och moderna CI/CD-flöden

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Robert Blomqvist på robert.blomqvist@skandia.se

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Madelene Skogh på madelene.skogh@skandia.se

Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

new_jobs.title: Senior .NET-utvecklare – API & tekniskt ledarskap
new_jobs.description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten

Vill du fortsätta vara hands-on i utvecklingen, men samtidigt få större möjlighet att påverka tekniska beslut och hur API-utvecklingen ska bedrivas?

Vi söker en senior .NET-utvecklare till ett mindre utvecklingsteam som arbetar med att modernisera en etablerad produkt (Lönessystemet POL). Fokus ligger på att utveckla API:er i C#/.NET med Kubernetes i en miljö där ny teknik möter befintlig arkitektur, kod och data.

Du kommer in i ett läge där det finns mycket att påverka. En del handlar om att bygga nytt, en annan om att förstå vad som redan finns och avgöra vad som ska behållas, förändras eller byggas om.

Teamet är litet och du kommer in som en nyckelperson från start. Med din seniora API-kompetens kliver du rakt in i de tekniska diskussionerna tillsammans med övriga seniora kollegor och får möjlighet att påverka både lösningar och vägval direkt. Här är det kort väg mellan idé och beslut och du får stort utrymme att förändra och förbättra. Du är samtidigt en del av det dagliga utvecklingsarbetet – det här är tekniskt ledarskap, inte personalansvar.

Vi använder givetvis AI som ett naturligt verktyg inom utvecklingen, men söker hela tiden nästa steg inom agentbaserad utveckling, som kan användas för att utveckla våra arbetssätt och lösningar.

Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du framför allt att:

Designa och utveckla moderna API:er i C#/.NET i en Kubernetes-baserad miljö.
Vara med och modernisera vår befintliga produkt med dess legacylösningar och göra tekniska vägval för hur de ska utvecklas vidare.
Ta ansvar för API-lösningen hela vägen från design och implementation men även vara djupt delaktig i hosting, CI/CD och deployment.
Vägleda andra utvecklare och vara ett stöd i tekniska diskussioner och vägval.
Ansvara för designfrågor kring bland annat idempotency, atomicity och concurrency.
Sätta dig in i befintlig kod, datamodeller och stored procedures och bedöma vad som kan återanvändas och vad som behöver förändras.
Samarbeta med DevOps- och infrastrukturkompetenser kring drift och deployment.
Bidra till och driva utvecklingen av teamets arbetssätt, bland annat inom AI och agentbaserad utveckling.

Vi tror på värdet av att träffas och arbeta tillsammans på plats. Det skapar både ett effektivt arbetssätt och ett nära samarbete i teamet. Därför ser vi gärna att du är på vårt kontor i Solna 2–3 dagar i veckan.

Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll

Vi söker dig som är en erfaren utvecklare och som är van att arbeta med API:er i komplexa systemmiljöer. För den här rollen är det särskilt viktigt att du har erfarenhet av API:er som skapar och uppdaterar verksamhetskritiska data.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

Mycket god erfarenhet av C#/.NET och API-utveckling, inklusive design och implementation av API:er för create- och update-operationer.
God förståelse för robust API-design, exempelvis concurrency, idempotency, retries, atomicity, transaktioner och datakonsistens.
Erfarenhet av lösningar där flera beroende databasändringar behöver genomföras tillsammans eller rullas tillbaka vid fel.
Erfarenhet av att integrera moderna API-lösningar med legacysystem och bedöma vad som kan återanvändas, behöver refaktoreras eller byggas om.
Förståelse för API:ets hela livscykel, inklusive containers, hosting, CI/CD och deployment.
Förmåga att göra välgrundade tekniska och arkitekturella vägval och förankra dem i teamet.
Förmåga att ta tekniskt ansvar och vägleda andra utvecklare, samtidigt som du själv arbetar hands-on.
Svenska i tal och skrift på professionell nivå.

Det är mycket meriterande om du har praktisk erfarenhet av Kubernetes och är van att deploya och drifta containeriserade applikationer. Erfarenhet av exempelvis Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, kubectl, YAML och Helm är särskilt relevant för vår miljö.

Erfarenhet av Azure, tekniskt arkitekturarbete, API- och applikationssäkerhet eller AI-assisterad/agentbaserad utveckling är meriterande.

Eftersom vi är ett litet team lägger vi stor vikt vid hur du fungerar tillsammans med andra. Vi söker dig som delar med dig av det du kan och samtidigt är öppen för andras perspektiv. Du kan stå för dina tekniska bedömningar och vågar ifrågasätta när du ser en bättre väg, utan att tappa samarbetet på vägen. Du tar ansvar för det du driver och är bekväm med att ta reda på vad som behövs när allt inte är färdigdefinierat.

Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning.

Om du har några frågor eller funderingar, kontakta gärna rekryterade chef Carl Gerhardsson via mail carl.gerhardsson@cgi.com

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.

Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.

Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.

Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.

Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.

Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

Vi er ikke på jakt etter én person som kan alt. Vi skal ansette flere og ønsker kolleger med ulike og utfyllende styrker.

Konfigurere og videreutvikle Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service og andre relevante løsninger
Bygge apper, automatiseringer og brukerflater med Power Apps, Power Automate og Power Pages
Utforme datamodeller og løsninger i Dataverse
Arbeide med integrasjoner, API-er, Azure-tjenester og teknisk arkitektur
Bidra med testing, migrering, dokumentasjon, opplæring og innføring
Se forbedringsmuligheter og hjelpe kundene med å ta gode valg videre

Den funksjonelle konsulenten

Du liker å forstå hvordan kunden arbeider i dag, hva som bør bli bedre, og hvordan teknologien kan støtte dette. Du har gjerne erfaring med behovskartlegging, prosessarbeid, konfigurasjon, krav, workshops, opplæring eller innføring av nye løsninger.

Du forstår både forretningsbehovene og de tekniske mulighetene. Du kan diskutere prosesser med kunden, samarbeide med utviklere og forklare tekniske valg på en forståelig måte.

Mange kombinerer elementer fra flere av disse profilene. Du trenger ikke å plassere deg i bare én kategori.

Vi ser først og fremst etter deg som:
Har praktisk erfaring med Dynamics 365 CE og/eller Power Platform
Har vært med på å levere eller videreutvikle løsninger i kundeprosjekter, produktteam eller interne digitaliseringsmiljøer
Forstår sammenhengen mellom prosesser, data, teknologi og brukerbehov
Liker kundedialog og kan stille gode spørsmål, gi råd og utfordre på en konstruktiv måte
Kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
Tar ansvar for egne leveranser og deler kunnskap med andre

new_jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Solution Engineer, Data & AI

Help Denmark’s leading organizations turn data into real-world impact

Do you believe the best Data & AI solutions are built by people who are curious, pragmatic and willing to challenge conventional thinking?

We are looking for a Solution Engineer, Data & AI
to join Microsoft’s Cloud & AI Solution Engineering team in Denmark. You will work with some of Denmark’s most ambitious organisations, helping them modernise their data platforms, prepare their data for AI and turn new technology into measurable business outcomes.

This is not a traditional pre-sales role. You will combine deep technical expertise with creativity, commercial understanding and a hands-on approach. You will engage directly with customers, shape technical strategy and prove what is possible through architecture workshops, demonstrations, rapid prototyping, proofs of concept and collaborative build engagements.

You may come from a large technology company, a consultancy, a scale-up or a startup where you have helped build new platforms, products or capabilities from the ground up. What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, simplify complexity and turn ambitious ideas into solutions that work.

Responsibilities

Lead technical sales conversations with customer technical and business decision-makers, using consultative discovery to understand requirements and connect technology decisions to business outcomes.
Design and recommend secure, scalable, resilient, and governed Data & AI architectures across database, analytics, data engineering, integration, and AI scenarios.
Lead architecture sessions, technical workshops, demonstrations, rapid prototypes, proofs of concept, MVPs, and pilots to validate solutions and influence technical decisions.
Work hands-on with customers to address technical requirements, resolve blockers, and guide the modernization and migration of database, data, and analytics workloads.
Build trusted relationships with customer architects, engineers, developers, data leaders, and business decision-makers, acting as a technical advisor throughout the sales and solution lifecycle.
Collaborate with Microsoft account teams, specialists, Solution Engineers, engineering teams, customer success teams, and partners to develop technical plans and support successful implementation and adoption.
Maintain and grow technical expertise across Data & AI and cloud technologies, sharing customer insights, technical knowledge, and reusable practices with the wider Solution Engineering community.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Technical pre-sales, technical consulting, technology sales, solution engineering, technology delivery, or equivalent experience.
Experience working with database solutions, analytical workloads, data engineering, or related Data & AI technologies in cloud or hybrid environments.
Experience engaging with customers and technical and business stakeholders to understand requirements, communicate technical concepts, and translate customer needs into technical solutions.
Experience delivering technical engagements such as architecture workshops, demonstrations, rapid prototypes, proofs of concept, MVPs, or pilots.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud-based data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure SQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Cosmos DB, or comparable cloud data technologies.
Knowledge of cloud architecture principles, including security, scalability, resiliency, governance, performance, and cost optimization.
Experience designing or advising on end-to-end data architectures spanning operational databases, data integration, analytics, governance, and AI scenarios.
Consultative technical selling skills, including discovery, active listening, storytelling, objection handling, and influencing technical and business decision-makers.

Solution Engineering IC4 - The typical base pay range for this role across Denmark is kr 600,000.00 - kr 986,400.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

Find Additional Benefits And Pay Information Here

https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/denmark-corporate-pay.html

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.
